verdict.line: You lose trades if you let him land Infernal Chains and chain into Darkin Blade before you have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste up; you win if you survive to the Heartsteel power spike and start threatening him with Devour.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains) plus his empowered Deathbringer Stance auto punishes any trade where you don't already have stacks built, while Tahm has zero hard CC of his own until three separate Q (Tongue Lash) hits land. That gap is exactly why Tahm sits at only 44.1% over 245 games here versus his 50.7% top-lane average — Aatrox gets to dictate the first three levels of trading, and Tahm has to play the stack-up game to even the fight.

theirWindow.when: after he lands Infernal Chains on you
theirWindow.what: W (Infernal Chains) damages you on impact and drags you back to center if you don't leave the area fast — that's the setup for his Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and E (Umbral Dash) follow-up. Per OP.GG, getting caught in that chain is what makes the rest of his combo nearly impossible to escape.

yourWindow.when: right after he dashes in with Umbral Dash
yourWindow.what: E (Umbral Dash) is his only gap-closer and reset tool, on a 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown — once he's spent it to engage, he has no way to disengage. Land Q (Tongue Lash) to slow and chase him down exactly as OP.GG recommends, since your own W (Abyssal Dive) is too slow on cooldown to rely on for this window.

powerCurve.note: Darkin Blade poke outranges your trades
Devour and World Ender both unlock
Heartsteel health scaling starts closing the gap
Tankiness and Devour threat outscale his burst

start.why: Doran's Shield's damage reduction on sustained poke blunts his Darkin Blade swings and Deathbringer Stance autos, which is the thing actually hurting you before level 6.

boots.why: His combo is almost entirely physical — Darkin Blade swings, Deathbringer Stance autos — so flat physical reduction cuts every piece of his trade pattern, not just one.

core.why: Early armor plus the grievous wounds-adjacent healing cut undercuts both his passive heal and his E (Umbral Dash) sustain on hit.
Stacks raw health, which directly scales your passive's bonus damage and makes your eventual Devour threat and Thick Skin shield both bigger.
Continues the health-into-damage scaling so you start actually threatening him back instead of just surviving.
Punishes his auto-reliant Deathbringer Stance procs and grievous-wounds his self-heal from E and his R sustain.

situational.when: the game goes long and you want more sustained damage instead of pure tank stats
you need wave clear and consistent AoE damage against a wider enemy comp
the enemy team adds real magic damage threats alongside Aatrox

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on the wave while you're soaking his poke, converting lane presence into health and bonus damage without needing to win early trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts 59.6% here versus Flash+Ignite's 42.1% — this matchup is about surviving the early trades and scaling, so Teleport lets you reset waves and arrive for the fights where Heartsteel and Devour actually matter instead of forcing an early kill you're not favored to get.

playing.title: Respect every Infernal Chains cast
playing.detail: W (Infernal Chains) hits the first enemy it touches and then drags them back to center if they don't clear the area fast — walk out immediately after getting hit, don't just stand still.

playing.title: Count his Darkin Blade swings
playing.detail: Q (The Darkin Blade) can swing up to three times, each covering a different area, on a cooldown that drops from 14s to 6s as he ranks it. Dodging the first swing doesn't mean you're safe from the second or third.

playing.title: Chase only after his E is spent
playing.detail: E (Umbral Dash) is his only dash. Once he's used it to engage, he has no reposition tool for its full cooldown — that's your window to land Q (Tongue Lash) and commit.

playing.title: Plan all-ins around your third Q
playing.detail: Q (Tongue Lash) only stuns once An Acquired Taste hits three stacks — you need three separate landed Q's (or auto procs) before the lockdown triggers, so don't expect instant CC on the first hit.

playing.title: Save Devour for his execute window
playing.detail: R (Devour) has 0 cooldown once you have 3 stacks — use it to pull him out of a fight entirely when he pops World Ender or goes for a kill, denying the healing he needs to close it out.

playing.title: Pop Thick Skin before trading
playing.detail: E (Thick Skin) passively banks a percent of damage taken while out of combat — activate the shield right before an auto exchange so the banked value is already converted when his Deathbringer Stance auto lands.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — stack timing, combo windows, cooldown counts — is my own read of the ability kit, not sampled data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (Q) as it will be difficult to escape from his combo afterwards. If he used his (E)-(Q) combo, dodge it and use [Q] to chase after him and deal damage.
